text_block_list.text: —Yup, thanks a bunch! Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Man, my stomach hurts from 
laughing. That was so unfair~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Never heard of this next comedy duo. I 
wonder what kinda manzai they'll do?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Pfft. Ahaha...! No way, that's totally 
foul play...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A day off full of laughter, letting all 
the tension out. Lucky Lilac seems to have 
gotten plenty of rest.
